strategies.name: melt_full_pipeline
strategies.desc: 从 analysis Rank 1 (score 116) 映射: Full pipeline with custom profile, multiple filters, multi-track, transitions, mix, and avformat encoding
strategies.command: AFL_NO_FORKSRV=1 TERM=xterm-256color MLT_REPOSITORY=/workspace/mlt/build_afl/out/lib/mlt MLT_DATA=/workspace/mlt/build_afl/out/share/mlt AFL_IGNORE_PROBLEMS=1 afl-fuzz -i /workspace/fuzz_mlt/seeds_media -o /workspace/fuzz_mlt/out_full_pipeline -m 4096 -t 10000 -x /workspace/fuzz_mlt/melt.dict -c /workspace/mlt/build_cmplog/out/bin/melt -- /workspace/mlt/build_afl/out/bin/melt -profile hdv_720p @@ -filter brightness gamma=1.2 -filter crop left=50 -track /workspace/fuzz_mlt/seeds_media/ref_seed.bin -transition composite geometry=10%:10%:30%x30% -mix 25 -mixer luma -consumer avformat /dev/null vcodec=libx264 acodec=aac preset=medium crf=18 progress2=true
